# Bulk irreversible action: create Simple Note notes from prepared payload
from pathlib import Path

# Rebuild payload once more to avoid any accidental mutation
file_pw = next(p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system')
sn_pw = next(p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note')
file_token = apis.file_system.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=file_pw)['access_token']
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)['access_token']

source_dir = '~/documents/personal/simple_note/'
all_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=source_dir, recursive=True, entry_type='files', access_token=file_token)
md_files = [p for p in all_files if str(p).lower().endswith(('.md','.markdown'))]

def title_from_path(p):
    name = Path(str(p)).name
    stem = Path(name).stem
    return stem.replace('_',' ')

payload = []
for p in md_files:
    content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=str(p), access_token=file_token)['content']
    payload.append({
        'source_file': str(p),
        'title': title_from_path(p),
        'content': content
    })

print('About to create notes:', len(payload))
print('Titles sample:', [x['title'] for x in payload[:10]])

results = []
for item in payload:
    try:
        r = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=item['title'], content=item['content'], access_token=sn_token)
        results.append({**item, 'status':'ok', 'resp': r})
